title: PowerDAO
tagline: PowerDAO enables miners to sell the future earnings/rewards of a certain amount of mining power with the community.
description:
PowerDAO enables miners to sell the future earnings of a certain amount of mining power with the community. The buyers (NFT holders) can benefit from earn future mining rewards without needing to setup and maintain servers.

1. The miner have to execute `mint` func to mint a splittable and mergeable NFT with some details like `name`, `description`, and `units` etc.

2. Buyers can buy a certain amount of units from an existing mining power backed NFT.

3. Buyers can split and merge owned same NFTs.
how_its_made:
This project is built atop of FEVM-Hardhat-Kit. And also used remix as the online IDE for speeding up code debugging.
